title: Racing championships and the Single Player profile
summary: Single Player now has a Championship page with the original Amateur and Pro Nationals and Supercross series, and shows the saved profile's Profile Points and race record.
details: Exact-build evidence: series are race event types whose course lists come from the front end's Tracks.dat in file order; round counts per Normal/Expert from a table read by 00322c20 (for example Amateur Supercross 6/7: sx08, sx12, sx01, sx13, sx02, sx06, sx05); 00289d50 sets five laps, four CPUs and Expert CPU difficulty.
Championship points 7/4/2/1/0 by place (001f1db0). After round r the player needs 4r+2 total points (00322c60/00322ed0); short of it the race's points are dropped and the round is replayed.

After the last round the player's rank gives gold/silver/bronze (00322440, ties go to the player); first-time trophy Profile Points (00322650: Amateur 500/250/125 Normal, 1500/750/375 Expert; Pro 1000/500/250 and 2000/1000/500); gold opens Expert and any Amateur trophy opens the Pro series (003238a0).

Race results add a championship line; Profile Points use the course TOY table for the series and difficulty; Quit Event returns to the Championship page. Single Player shows "Profile Points N · R races · W wins".

Verification: atv-core championship tests, atv-ui controller test, new browser tests test_engine_championship.mjs (menu -> final Amateur Supercross round on SX06 under the race path driver: 1st place, Gold, +500 reward, +60 course Profile Points, Pro Supercross and Amateur Supercross Expert unlocked, Championship page updated) and test_engine_profile_menu.mjs; existing menu and race tests pass.
limitation: Round-to-course mapping is a strong code reading, not a runtime trace.
